001: Good morning, Ivan! How was your evening?
Hi, Anna! It was good, I went to the gym and relaxed.
Great! And I spent the whole evening preparing a report for the boss.
That sounds tiring. I hope you didn't stay up too late?
A little, but I managed to finish everything.
Good job! Maybe we can go to lunch together today?
002: Sergey, have you seen my notebook? I put it somewhere.
I think I saw it in the meeting room.
Right, I went there to write down ideas for the project.
I'm actually heading there now, I can bring it to you.
I'd be very grateful, you'd really save me.
No problem, I need to go there anyway.
003: Dmitry, what do you think of the new design of our website?
Honestly, I think the colors are too bright.
Really? I thought it draws attention.
Maybe, but for our audience it's better to choose calmer tones.
Good point. Maybe we can discuss this at the meeting?
Yes, let's propose it to everyone together.
004: Alexey, have you finished the sales report yet?
Almost, I just need to double-check a couple of numbers.
The boss asked to submit it by the end of the day.
I know, I'll make it. I just need to confirm the data with the purchasing department.
If you need help, I can call them.
Thanks, but I can handle it myself. It won't take long.
005: Olga, do you know when the next meeting is?
And what time exactly? I need to put it in my calendar.
At three o'clock, in the big meeting room.
Thanks! And have you already prepared your presentation?
Not yet, but I'm planning to work on it tomorrow morning.
006: Ivan, I heard you got a promotion. Congratulations!
Thanks, Anna. I'm really happy, but now there will be more work.
I'm sure you'll handle it. You always do a great job.
I try. But I'll miss working together.
We'll still talk, I work in the office next door.
That's true. Then we'll see each other just as often.
007: Sergey, could you help me with my computer? It froze.
Sure, let me take a look. What were you doing before that?
I opened a lot of programs at the same time, that's probably why.
I see. Try closing the extra tabs, and it'll start working.
Oh, it works now. Thank you so much!
Let me know if anything else happens.
008: Dmitry, are you going to the company party on Friday?
Yes, I already signed up. And you?
Me too. They say it's going to be a lot of fun.
I hope there will be good music and tasty food.
I was told they booked a great restaurant.
Then I can't wait for Friday!
009: Alexey, how did the meeting with the new client go?
Overall, not bad, but he asked to lower the price.
And what did you tell him?
I said we can discuss it with a large order.
The right decision. I hope he'll agree.
Me too. He promised to give an answer early next week.
010: Olga, do you know where to find the documents from the last project?
They should be in the shared folder on the server.
I looked there, but I couldn't find the right folder.
That's strange. Let me check on my end, maybe I saved them on a different drive.
I'd really appreciate it if you could help.
Of course, I'll take a look now and text you.
